subject: general
question: The picture of smoke rising from an apartment depicted:

options.text: thick smoke due to bad lighting

solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. **'****Israeli airstrike on Lebanon'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** first sentence of the second paragraph **says " the smoke billowing from an apartment block after an Israeli air strike..."
 
• From the above sentence, we can say that** the Israeli air force airstrikes an apartment block in Lebanon and smoke was rising from that apartment.**

 

Hence, the only possible answer is option 1.
